title: 工業力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Engineering Mechanics II
teachers:
SUWABE Hitoshi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will learn:
(1)Newton's laws of motion.
(2)Motion of mass or rigid body subjected force or torque.
(3)Basics of dynamics.
(4)Inertial forces and other factors necessary for designing high-speed machines.
advice:
Students will learn methods for analyzing the motion of mass points and rigid bodies by solving equations of motion through exercises based on the items. We will cover the following topics:
1. Motion of mass
2. Laws of motion
3. Inertia, centripetal and centrifugal forces
4. Moment of inertia
5. Planar motion of rigid bodies

Students are required to understand these concepts, tackle practice problems, and then cultivate the ability to apply their knowledge to practical problems.
Students are also required to tackle exercises using schematic drawings, and then imagine the application of forces and moments and the subsequent motion of mass points and rigid bodies.
Students are expected to pay attention to significant figures and units.
books: 工業力学　森北出版
requiredKnowledge: It is important to try a lot of exercises. A good understanding of high school math and physics is needed. Always use a scientific calculator in class. Students with poor attitudes may be asked to leave and may not be allowed to attend. Recommend using office hours. In addition, the content of this class is indispensable for understanding of specialized subjects in the next year.

activityGoals.body: Be able to build an equation of motion for a mass and calculate its velocity and location.
Be able to explain the laws of motion and calculate inertial, centripetal and centrifugal forces.
Be able to calculate the moment of inertia.
Be able to build equations of motion or machine models.
Be able to solve equations of motion by applying mathematics
